assertions.name: mean_occupancy_from_the_moment_equals_one_plus_tanh_eta_over_two
assertions.source: explicit first moment <k>/n over the rebuilt Z(12) coefficients at Q = q_0^2, vs the free two-level closed form (1 + tanh eta_0)/2 with eta_0 = log q_0. Agreement is what makes Q a fugacity conjugate to k rather than a formal variable.

assertions.name: polarization_is_the_corpus_coulomb_strong_ratio
assertions.source: 2<k>/n - 1 from the moment above, vs tanh(ln q_0) -- the 'derived Coulomb/strong ratio' of def:coulomb-charge, used by charge_coulomb_tn3he_derived.py, em_linking_invariant_probe.py and six others. The corpus reaches it as the antisymmetric/symmetric ratio (q-1/q)/(q+1/q) of E_cross at n_- = 0; multiplying through by q gives (Q-1)/(Q+1). NOT a new constant -- a second reading of one.

assertions.name: legendre_transform_of_log_Z_is_the_binary_shannon_entropy
assertions.source: S/n = log Z/n - (<k>/n)*log Q, the Legendre transform of the grand potential in the field log Q, vs the binary Shannon entropy H(p) of the occupancy p measured above. Two different constructions; agreement is what makes S an entropy rather than a leftover.

assertions.name: coefficients_are_bare_multiplicities_so_there_is_no_boltzmann_weight
assertions.source: every coefficient of Q^k in the rebuilt Z(12) is a q-INDEPENDENT integer equal to C(12,k). A Hamiltonian would put Omega_k * exp(-beta E_k) there. So the spectrum is linear in k, the only q is the fugacity, and nothing in Z fixes beta or mu separately -- only the product beta*mu = log Q = 2*eta_0.

description: The framework's normaliser Z(n) = (1+q^2)^n IS a grand partition function: q^2 is a fugacity conjugate to the strand-state count k, the Legendre transform is a Shannon entropy, and the polarization is the corpus's own Coulomb/strong ratio. But the coefficients are the bare binomials -- no Boltzmann weight -- so only the product beta*mu = 2*eta_0 is fixed and the temperature is STRUCTURALLY absent, not merely unfound. A1 dies on structural grounds.

the_conjugate_pair.conjugate_variable: k, the number of strands in the second state

entropy_expansion.reading: S/n = log 2 - eta_0^2/2 + O(eta_0^4); the entropy deficit from maximal is eta_0^2/2 = 0.005443493 nats per strand.

why_there_is_no_temperature.what_is_fixed: the product beta*mu = log Q = 2 eta_0 = 0.208681440639
why_there_is_no_temperature.what_is_not: beta alone. It appears nowhere in the construction.
why_there_is_no_temperature.the_reason: the spectrum is LINEAR in k and the multiplicities are the bare binomials, so Z is a free two-level system with a single dimensionless field. Rescaling beta and mu inversely leaves Z unchanged -- there is no intrinsic energy scale to extract.
why_there_is_no_temperature.upgrade_over_qou-ap3d: that bean recorded an EMPIRICAL negative (the corpus's Landauer probe found no candidate kT within 5%, off by 41.9x-4266x). This is the REASON: the construction cannot contain one.

data.A1_verdict: A1 ('the extensive term is the Markov normalisation; stop dividing it out') is DEAD ON STRUCTURAL GROUNDS. What it retains is log Z = S + beta*mu*<k>, a Shannon entropy plus a dimensionless field term, both pure numbers BY CONSTRUCTION. No member of the normalisation family and no choice among the four E_0 conventions can make it an energy, because the framework contains no 1/beta. qou-78pt was reopened when its numerical refutation was withdrawn; it can now close for the right reason -- not 'no member reaches the target' but 'no member is an energy'.

the_coulomb_ratio_is_not_a_new_constant.corpus_route: def:coulomb-charge -- antisymmetric/symmetric channel ratio of E_cross = n_+ q - n_- q^{-1} at n_- = 0, i.e. (q-1/q)/(q+1/q)
the_coulomb_ratio_is_not_a_new_constant.this_route: polarization 2<k>/n - 1 = (Q-1)/(Q+1) of the fugacity two-level system
the_coulomb_ratio_is_not_a_new_constant.why_identical: multiply (q-1/q)/(q+1/q) top and bottom by q to get (q^2-1)/(q^2+1) = (Q-1)/(Q+1). One line of algebra; not a coincidence and not a new derivation.
the_coulomb_ratio_is_not_a_new_constant.what_is_new: the READING. The same ratio is simultaneously an energy ratio and a thermal polarization. Being a ratio it is scale-free either way, which is exactly why it survives where the extensive magnitude does not. The framework's derived quantities are ratios and polarizations; its one absolute magnitude is the one with no scale.
